goal: A higher-quality target for one character (نبيه), to guide a better Blender model. See docs/art/visual-brief.md.

blocks.identity: The attached image is the current 3D model of NABEEH, the small friendly robot host of an Arabic children's learning game. Keep his identity exactly: big round pale head on a round ball body, sky-blue baseball cap with a small sunflower-yellow eight-point star, big round dark-framed glasses, painted friendly eyes and a small smile, a keypad of 3x3 pastel buttons on his chest, short arms with white mitten hands, blue-and-white sneakers, a small red book. Same proportions, same colours, same cheerful personality.
blocks.quality: Re-imagine him as a premium collectible designer-toy character from a top animation studio's feature film: beautifully sculpted appealing forms, subtle asymmetry in the pose, soft satin vinyl with gentle subsurface glow, crisp panel seams and tiny well-designed details (stitching on the cap, moulded rubber sneaker soles with laces, rounded keypad buttons with soft bevels, real glass lenses in the glasses, a hardcover book with a ribbon). Warm soft studio lighting, soft contact shadow, gentle ambient occlusion, clean warm cream background. Still simple enough to build from rounded shapes: no fine wrinkles, no realistic skin or scratches.
blocks.hero: COMPOSITION: full body, three-quarter view, standing, waving with one hand and holding the red book under the other arm. Centred, plenty of margin.
blocks.front: COMPOSITION: full body, straight-on front view, relaxed standing pose, arms slightly away from the body so every shape reads clearly. Centred, plenty of margin. Plain background, like a model sheet.
blocks.constraints: No text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere.
